sessions.title: A Verb and noun collocations
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm động từ và danh từ thường đi kèm với nhau khi diễn đạt sự đồng tình và không đồng tình.
sessions.value:
# Agreeing and disagreeing

## A Verb and noun collocations

| collocation                                            | example                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **go along with an idea / a view**                     | I **go along with your view** that crime and poverty are linked.                                                                                     |
| **be in (complete) agreement**                         | We are in **complete agreement** over the question of drug abuse in athletics.                                                                       |
| **tend to agree/disagree**                             | I **tend to agree** that parents often blame teachers for problems which start within the family.                                                    |
| **share an opinion / a view**                          | I **share your opinion** that sport is over-commercialised.                                                                                          |
| **appreciate someone’s point of view**                 | I **appreciate your point of view**, but I still think you are overstating the problem.                                                              |
| **see someone’s point** [understand their opinion]     | I can **see your point**; I’ve never thought of it in that way before.                                                                               |
| **enter into an argument**                             | I’d prefer not to **enter into an argument** over the result of the elections.                                                                       |
| **differences arise/exist**                            | **Differences exist / have arisen** between the unions and the management over how to solve the problem.                                             |
| **come to / reach a compromise**                       | We disagree over what to do, but I’m sure we can **come to / reach a compromise**.                                                                   |
| **settle a dispute / your differences**                | The management and the union have finally **settled their pay dispute**. I’m sure we can **settle our differences** without damaging our friendship. |
| **agree to differ** [agree to have different opinions] | I don’t think we will ever agree with each other. We’ll just have to **agree to differ**.                                                            |

children_nodes.label: go along with an idea / a view

sessions.title: B Verb and adverb collocations
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm động từ và trạng từ thường đi kèm với nhau khi diễn đạt mức độ đồng tình hoặc không đồng tình.
sessions.value:
# Agreeing and disagreeing

## B Verb and adverb collocations

| verb     | adverb                                 | example                                                                                           |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| agree    | **entirely / wholeheartedly**          | I **entirely agree** with you on the question of nuclear waste.                                   |
| agree    | **partly / up to a point**             | I **agree up to a point**, but I also think there are other important factors.                    |
| disagree | **fundamentally / totally / strongly** | The two philosophers **disagreed fundamentally** over the effect of the environment on behaviour. |

children_nodes.label: agree partly / up to a point

sessions.title: C Adjective and noun collocations for disputes and strong disagreements
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm tính từ và danh từ dùng để mô tả các cuộc tranh chấp và bất đồng quan điểm gay gắt.
sessions.value:
# Agreeing and disagreeing

## C Adjective and noun collocations for disputes and strong disagreements

I’ve often **disagreed strongly** with Nancy but I’ve never had such a **head-on clash** with her before.
[disagreement where two people confront each other directly]
The **bitter dispute** between the two groups finally led to violence.
We had a very **heated argument** about immigration the other day.
Jeff and I had a **fundamental disagreement** over who should be the next Chair of the club.

sessions.title: D Further collocations for agreeing and disagreeing
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ bổ sung để diễn đạt sự đồng tình và không đồng tình.
sessions.value:
# Agreeing and disagreeing

## D Further collocations for agreeing and disagreeing

The Regional Education Committee has reached a **unanimous agreement** on a new system of exams for secondary schools.
**Controversy continues to exist/rage** over the appointment of the new Director.
A **conflict of opinion** within the National Olympic Association is threatening to delay the building of a new stadium.

image.value: An image representing agreement or acceptance of an idea or view.

senses.definition_vi: Đồng ý hoặc chấp nhận một ý tưởng, quan điểm hoặc kế hoạch của người khác.
examples: I **go along with** your view that crime and poverty are linked.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để diễn tả sự đồng tình một cách tương đối, không nhất thiết là hoàn toàn.

use_prompts.question: Do you usually accept your manager's ideas even when you are not sure about them?
Do young people in your country usually follow their parents' wishes about careers?
Why do people often accept the opinion of the majority?

dictation.text: I go along with your idea about the trip.

paraphrase.source: I agree with your view that crime and poverty are linked.
paraphrase.model: I go along with your view that crime and poverty are linked.

paraphrase.source: Most staff accepted the manager's plan without complaining.
paraphrase.model: Most staff were happy to go along with the manager's plan.

image.value: An image representing two or more people in accord.

senses.definition_vi: Có cùng ý kiến hoặc quan điểm với người khác.
examples: We are in **complete agreement** over the question of drug abuse in athletics.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Có thể thêm 'complete' để nhấn mạnh sự đồng tình hoàn toàn.

use_prompts.question: How can a team make decisions when its members have different opinions?
Do most countries now accept that climate change is a serious problem?
Do you and your parents share the same views about your future?

dictation.text: My parents are in agreement about my studies.

paraphrase.source: All the scientists agree that the drug is safe.
paraphrase.model: All the scientists are in agreement that the drug is safe.

paraphrase.source: The two countries share the same view on trade.
paraphrase.model: The two countries are in agreement on trade.

image.value: An image showing a person leaning towards agreement or disagreement.

senses.definition_vi: Có xu hướng đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý với một quan điểm hoặc ý kiến nào đó.
examples: I **tend to agree** that parents often blame teachers for problems which start within the family.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả một xu hướng hoặc khả năng cao sẽ đồng ý/không đồng ý, không phải là sự đồng tình tuyệt đối.

use_prompts.question: Do you think homework is necessary for young children?
Some people say smartphones make us less social. What is your view?
Is it true that people today are less polite than in the past?

dictation.text: I tend to agree that homework is useful.

paraphrase.source: In general, I think that parents are partly responsible for their children's behaviour.
paraphrase.model: I tend to agree that parents are partly responsible for their children's behaviour.

paraphrase.source: I usually do not accept the idea that money brings happiness.
paraphrase.model: I tend to disagree with the idea that money brings happiness.

image.value: An image of people exchanging thoughts or ideas.

senses.definition_vi: Có cùng ý kiến hoặc quan điểm với người khác.
examples: I **share your opinion** that sport is over-commercialised.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Tương tự như 'agree with someone', nhưng nhấn mạnh vào việc có chung một suy nghĩ.

use_prompts.question: Do you and your friends usually like the same films and shows?
Do you agree with people who say sport has become too commercial?
Do you and your parents think the same way about money?

dictation.text: I share your opinion about the new film.

paraphrase.source: I agree with your belief that sport is too commercial.
paraphrase.model: I share your opinion that sport is too commercial.

paraphrase.source: Many people think the same as the minister about tax.
paraphrase.model: Many people share the minister's view about tax.

image.value: An image of someone listening attentively to another person's perspective.

senses.definition_vi: Hiểu và công nhận quan điểm hoặc cách nhìn nhận vấn đề của người khác, ngay cả khi bạn không hoàn toàn đồng ý.
examples: I **appreciate your point of view**, but I still think you are overstating the problem.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thể hiện sự tôn trọng đối với quan điểm của người khác.

use_prompts.question: How should parents respond when teenagers disagree with them?
How can managers handle disagreements in a team?
How can people with very different political views talk calmly?

dictation.text: I appreciate your point of view, but I still disagree.

paraphrase.source: I understand why you think that, but I still believe you are exaggerating.
paraphrase.model: I appreciate your point of view, but I still believe you are exaggerating.

paraphrase.source: Good managers try to understand how their staff see things.
paraphrase.model: Good managers try to appreciate their staff's point of view.

image.value: An image of a lightbulb turning on above someone's head, symbolizing understanding.

senses.definition_vi: Hiểu được lý do hoặc quan điểm của ai đó.
examples: I can **see your point**; I’ve never thought of it in that way before.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng khi bạn bắt đầu hiểu hoặc đồng ý với lý do của người khác sau khi họ giải thích.

use_prompts.question: Has a teacher ever changed your mind about something?
Do you find it easy to understand your parents' opinions?
How do you react when a colleague criticises your idea?

dictation.text: I can see your point about the cost.

paraphrase.source: I understand what you mean, although I still disagree.
paraphrase.model: I can see your point, although I still disagree.

paraphrase.source: After a long talk, my father finally understood why I wanted to study art.
paraphrase.model: After a long talk, my father could finally see my point about studying art.

image.value: An image depicting two people in a heated discussion or debate.

senses.definition_vi: Bắt đầu tranh cãi hoặc tham gia vào một cuộc tranh luận.
examples: I’d prefer not to **enter into an argument** over the result of the elections.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường mang nghĩa tiêu cực, ám chỉ việc bắt đầu một cuộc cãi vã không mong muốn.

use_prompts.question: Do you ever discuss politics with people you do not know well?
Is it a good idea to disagree openly with your boss?
Why do people often fight with strangers on social media?

dictation.text: I prefer not to enter into an argument about politics.

paraphrase.source: She refused to start debating with him about the election result.
paraphrase.model: She refused to enter into an argument with him about the election result.

paraphrase.source: It is not wise to begin a dispute with customers online.
paraphrase.model: It is not wise to enter into an argument with customers online.

image.value: An image showing diverging paths or contrasting elements.

senses.definition_vi: Sự khác biệt hoặc bất đồng bắt đầu xuất hiện hoặc tồn tại giữa các cá nhân hoặc nhóm.
examples: **Differences exist / have arisen** between the unions and the management over how to solve the problem.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ sự tồn tại hoặc nảy sinh của các bất đồng quan điểm.

use_prompts.question: What problems can happen between workers and managers?
Why do parents and teenagers often disagree?
What problems might people face when they marry someone from another culture?

dictation.text: Differences often arise between parents and teenagers.

paraphrase.source: People of different generations often have conflicting views about technology.
paraphrase.model: Differences often arise between generations over technology.

paraphrase.source: The two countries disagree with each other over fishing rights.
paraphrase.model: Differences exist between the two countries over fishing rights.

image.value: An image of two hands shaking or a scale balancing two objects.

senses.definition_vi: Đạt được một thỏa hiệp, một giải pháp mà mỗi bên đều nhượng bộ một phần.
examples: We disagree over what to do, but I’m sure we can **come to / reach a compromise**.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc tìm ra điểm chung hoặc giải pháp dung hòa khi có bất đồng.

use_prompts.question: How should a company and its employees settle disagreements over pay?
How do couples decide where to spend their holidays?
How can governments balance economic growth and protecting nature?

dictation.text: I am sure we can reach a compromise soon.

paraphrase.source: After long talks, both sides agreed to accept a solution halfway between their positions.
paraphrase.model: After long talks, both sides managed to reach a compromise.

paraphrase.source: My brother and I each gave up something so that we could share the car.
paraphrase.model: My brother and I were able to come to a compromise about sharing the car.

image.value: An image of two people shaking hands after a disagreement.

senses.definition_vi: Giải quyết một tranh chấp hoặc bất đồng giữa các bên.
examples: The management and the union have finally **settled their pay dispute**. I’m sure we can **settle our differences** without damaging our friendship.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Hành động chấm dứt một cuộc tranh cãi hoặc mâu thuẫn.

use_prompts.question: How can employers and unions avoid strikes?
How should brothers and sisters solve their arguments?
Should neighbours go to court when they disagree?

dictation.text: The two neighbours finally settled their dispute.

paraphrase.source: The company and the workers have finally ended their argument about pay.
paraphrase.model: The company and the workers have finally settled their pay dispute.

paraphrase.source: Good friends can usually solve their disagreements without hurting each other.
paraphrase.model: Good friends can usually settle their differences without hurting each other.

image.value: An image of two people walking away from each other with a neutral expression.

senses.definition_vi: Đồng ý rằng mỗi người sẽ giữ quan điểm riêng của mình và không cố gắng thuyết phục người kia, chấp nhận sự khác biệt.
examples: I don’t think we will ever agree with each other. We’ll just have to **agree to differ**.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi hai bên nhận thấy không thể đi đến thống nhất và quyết định dừng tranh luận.

use_prompts.question: What do you do when you and a friend cannot agree about something?
Is it possible to stay friends with someone who has very different political views?
How should colleagues handle a disagreement that cannot be solved?

dictation.text: We will just have to agree to differ.

paraphrase.source: We will never think the same way, so let us accept that we have different opinions.
paraphrase.model: We will never think the same way, so let us agree to differ.

paraphrase.source: My father and I accept that we disagree about football and stay friends.
paraphrase.model: My father and I agree to differ about football.

image.value: An image of someone enthusiastically nodding in agreement.

senses.definition_vi: Hoàn toàn đồng ý, không có chút do dự hay phản đối nào.
examples: I **entirely agree** with you on the question of nuclear waste.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh mức độ đồng tình cao nhất.

use_prompts.question: Should governments do more to reduce plastic waste?
Should smoking be banned in all public places?
Should every child have the chance to go to university?

dictation.text: I agree entirely with your plan.

paraphrase.source: I completely share your view on nuclear waste.
paraphrase.model: I entirely agree with you on nuclear waste.

paraphrase.source: The committee fully and enthusiastically supported the new proposal.
paraphrase.model: The committee agreed wholeheartedly with the new proposal.

agree_partly_up_to_point.word: agree partly / up to a point

image.value: An image of someone hesitating or showing partial agreement.

senses.definition_vi: Đồng ý một phần, hoặc đồng ý đến một mức độ nhất định, nhưng vẫn còn những điểm không đồng tình.
examples: I **agree up to a point**, but I also think there are other important factors.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự đồng tình có giới hạn, thường đi kèm với một lời phản bác hoặc bổ sung.

use_prompts.question: Do you think technology has made our lives better?
Are exams the best way to test students?
Is money the most important reason for working?

dictation.target: agree partly / up to a point
dictation.text: I agree up to a point, but not completely.

paraphrase.target: agree partly / up to a point
paraphrase.source: I think you are right about some things, but there are other factors too.
paraphrase.model: I agree up to a point, but there are other factors too.

paraphrase.target: agree partly / up to a point
paraphrase.source: In my opinion, some of the report's ideas are right, but not all of them.
paraphrase.model: I partly agree with the report.

image.value: An image of two people with crossed arms, showing strong opposition.

senses.definition_vi: Hoàn toàn hoặc rất mạnh mẽ không đồng ý với ai đó hoặc điều gì đó.
examples: The two philosophers **disagreed fundamentally** over the effect of the environment on behaviour.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh mức độ không đồng tình cao.

use_prompts.question: Are there any laws in your country that you think are completely wrong?
What do you think about the idea that children should start school at three?
Some people say fast food should be banned. What do you think?

dictation.text: I disagree strongly with this new law.

paraphrase.source: The two experts have completely different basic ideas about how children learn.
paraphrase.model: The two experts disagree fundamentally about how children learn.

paraphrase.source: I do not accept at all that young people are lazy.
paraphrase.model: I totally disagree that young people are lazy.

image.value: An image of two cars colliding head-on.

senses.definition_vi: Một cuộc đối đầu hoặc bất đồng trực diện, gay gắt giữa hai người hoặc hai nhóm.
examples: I’ve often disagreed strongly with Nancy but I’ve never had such a **head-on clash** with her before.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả sự đối đầu trực tiếp và không khoan nhượng.

use_prompts.question: Have you ever had a serious, direct disagreement with a colleague?
Why do some political debates become so aggressive?
Do teenagers often argue openly with their parents?

dictation.text: I had a head-on clash with my boss today.

paraphrase.source: The two leaders openly and directly fought over the new tax.
paraphrase.model: The two leaders had a head-on clash over the new tax.

paraphrase.source: My sister and I strongly and directly disagreed about the wedding plans.
paraphrase.model: My sister and I had a head-on clash about the wedding plans.

image.value: An image depicting a tense and angry confrontation.

senses.definition_vi: Một cuộc tranh chấp hoặc bất đồng sâu sắc, gây ra sự tức giận và oán giận.
examples: The **bitter dispute** between the two groups finally led to violence.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh tính chất cay đắng, thù địch của cuộc tranh chấp.

use_prompts.question: What can happen when a company and its workers cannot agree on pay?
Why do some families fight over money after a relative dies?

dictation.text: The bitter dispute between the neighbours lasted for years.

paraphrase.model: The two families have been in a bitter dispute over the land for many years.

paraphrase.source: The angry, long-running disagreement between the workers and the owners ended in a strike.
paraphrase.model: The bitter dispute between the workers and the owners ended in a strike.

image.value: An image of people arguing with flushed faces and animated gestures.

senses.definition_vi: Một cuộc tranh luận hoặc cãi vã sôi nổi, thường đi kèm với sự tức giận và cảm xúc mạnh.
examples: We had a very **heated argument** about immigration the other day.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mô tả cuộc tranh cãi diễn ra với cường độ cảm xúc cao.

use_prompts.question: Which topics often cause strong disagreements between people in your country?

paraphrase.model: My friends and I had a heated argument about immigration yesterday.

paraphrase.source: The politicians shouted at each other during the debate on taxes.
paraphrase.model: The politicians had a heated argument during the debate on taxes.

image.value: An image showing two deeply divided paths or foundations.

senses.definition_vi: Sự bất đồng về những vấn đề cốt lõi, cơ bản nhất.

senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ ra sự khác biệt ở cấp độ gốc rễ, khó có thể dung hòa.

use_prompts.question: Do parents and teachers sometimes have very different ideas about education?
Why is it hard for political parties to work together?
